release_read.basis: Diluted EPS $0.13 against a $0.03-0.05 bar (Nasdaq fallback $0.03, one estimate), revenue +11% y/y to $188.6m against a flat-revenue consensus with Products +17% and gross margin 57.7% vs 55.2%, plus a $0.70 special dividend (about 11-12% of the $6.05 spot) on top of the $0.10 recurring; the August print with a smaller dividend-free beat moved +22.9%, engaged users flat and subscribers +2% are the only soft lines.

guidance.detail: Cricut gives no numerical outlook in the release.

call.detail: Call held last night at 5pm ET; transcript content not reviewed in the time available. No call risk during today's session.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions or current-quarter articles found in one search before the open. Precedent snippets only: in May 2025 a special dividend with a beat took the stock up about 8.5% after hours and about 13% in regular trading (itiger, snippet_only), and in May 2023 a $1 special dividend drove a ~29% close.

tape_read.vs_implied_move: far beyond (historical-reaction proxy 5.21%; no option chain)
tape_read.note: Robust reference 6.89 (+15.4%) against a frozen release read of +17%: fair, at most a slight undershoot. After-hours 6.86 (+14.9%), pre-market range 6.58-7.06. Stale: 17 prints, none in the last 30 minutes, last at 08:07, so the open is uncertain. Market is up (SPY +1.2%, IWM +1.8%), a tailwind for a small cap.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was a low EPS bar under the CFO's run-rate plus Maker 5 sell-in: EPS $0.13 vs $0.03-0.05 and Products +17% confirm both; the special dividend is an extra not in the thesis.

expected.open_lag_note: The after-hours and pre-market agree near +15% and the news is unambiguous, so the open probably holds most of the move despite a stale tape (last print 08:07); a gap this large tends to give some back by 10:00, partly offset by the special dividend's yield support and a firm small-cap tape.

recommendation.limit_basis: The pre-market high (7.057), about +18% vs yesterday's close: inside the pre-market range and just above the frozen +17% release read; this name has extended dividend-plus-beat gaps in the session before (May 2025, Aug 2026 +22.9%).
recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn duidelijk beter dan verwacht (winst per aandeel $0,13 tegen ongeveer $0,03) en er komt een extra dividend van $0,70, ruim 11% van de koers. De voorbeurs staat al op +15%, vrijwel wat de cijfers rechtvaardigen, maar de laatste voorbeurshandel was om 08:07 en is dus oud. Zet een verkooplimiet op $7,05 (de hoogste voorbeurskoers); wordt die niet geraakt, dan gaat de positie bij het slot.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Zakt de koers voor 09:30 duidelijk onder $6,70 of komt er een negatieve analistenreactie, verkoop dan gewoon bij de opening.
